feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: Canada claps back at Trump's efforts to rename Lake Ontario as 'Lake America'
entry.summary: Ontario Premier Doug Ford has unveiled a giant billboard reading: "Lake Ontario — Now and Always." But tech giant Google has said it is renaming the lake for U.S. users, as President Trump demanded.

entry.title: Are you sure that Kimmel clip was real? Late-night AI deepfakes are spreading online
entry.summary: While social media is rife with AI celebrity deepfakes, videos featuring late night TV hosts like Jimmy Kimmel and Jon Stewart are are easier to create than other kinds of deepfakes and potentially more disruptive.

entry.title: 'A glorious dawn launch': NASA's newest space telescope has left the Earth
entry.summary: The tour-bus-sized telescope aims to unravel cosmic mysteries and identify more than 100,000 planets beyond our solar system.

entry.title: How a comic book store got swept into the tariff storm
entry.summary: Tariffs continue to rile all kinds of American businesses more than a year after Trump unveiled his first set of tariffs — including a comic book store owner in Ohio.

entry.title: From Appalachia to Africa: Why Dolly Parton was beloved across the continent
entry.summary: Dolly Parton's songs traveled far beyond Nashville. Across Africa, musicians embraced her stories of hardship, heartbreak and humble beginnings — and made them their own.

entry.title: Nepal warns of possible fresh flooding as communities grapple with devastation
entry.summary: Authorities in Nepal warned of possible fresh flooding on Sunday and urged residents in flood-affected districts to remain on high alert after water levels rose in the Bhotekoshi River.

entry.title: Medicare's pilot GLP-1 discount program has a catch. Some sick patients don't qualify
entry.summary: Medicare launched a pilot program that could streamline the process to get GLP-1s, with some seniors paying just $50 a month. But many people with the most serious illnesses won't get that discount.

entry.title: Trump administration deports relative of Afghans who helped US military to Central African Republic
entry.summary: His family in Afghanistan had received threats from the Taliban because of the work performed by his brothers in support of the U.S. military.

entry.title: We tested how AI chatbots would handle foreign propaganda. They did surprisingly well
entry.summary: In a test, popular AI chatbots mostly debunked falsehoods spread by other countries and avoided uncritically spreading falsehoods better than search engines. AI summaries above search results fared worse.

entry.title: Icelanders vote 'no' to talks aimed at joining the EU in close referendum
entry.summary: The vote against the EU led by 52.8 percent with nearly all votes counted, according to RÚV, Iceland's broadcaster.
